name: Thunderbrew
summary: In Westfall, Grimbooze Thunderbrew is gathering what he needs for his next batch. Fresh hops keep his ale from turning thick as stew, and he shares kegs with those who help.

sections.title: A Dwarven Passion in Westfall
sections.body: Grimbooze Thunderbrew keeps his family's brewing tradition alive far from Dun Morogh. Even across Westfall's turbulent plains, he insists on the right ingredients: without proper hops, his current brew may turn into thick stew instead of refreshing ale.

sections.title: The Art of the Keg
sections.body: Grimbooze celebrates hops, barley, yeast, and malt in cheerful rhymes. With fresh hops, he finishes the fermentation on the spot. Those who supply him receive whole kegs of Thunderbrew Lager, a brew known for its forceful taste.

faq.answer: Grimbooze Thunderbrew is a dwarven brewer who roams Westfall. He carries on his clan's brewing tradition wherever he camps, speaking and chanting in cheerful rhymes.
Without fresh hops, Grimbooze's latest batch may taste thick and heavy like stew instead of crisp lager. Hops bring bitterness and balance to the brew.
Thunderbrew Lager is a potent dwarven drink made by the Thunderbrew family. Grimbooze shares it by the keg, and its strong taste hits the palate hard.

faq.q: Can you bring Grimbooze hops more than once?
faq.answer: Yes. Grimbooze welcomes more hops and offers additional kegs of his brew in return.

faq.q: Where does this task take place?
faq.answer: The work takes place in Westfall, where Grimbooze camps and gathers supplies among the farmlands.

faq.q: Is Grimbooze related to the Thunderbrews in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Yes. Grimbooze shares his surname and brewing trade with the Thunderbrew family of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing a kinsman keep Kharanos's brewing traditions alive on Westfall's rugged frontier is a welcome sight, especially when kegs are involved.
As a cook, you know how barley, malt, and hops must balance, much like the ingredients in classic dwarven brewing.
